uncertainRequests: retain reservation, stop trajectory, never automatically retry or resume
capScope: initial and changed conditions together; identical caps do not mean identical actual consumption
toolPolicy: same search_materials and calculate implementations; deterministic constraint comparisons do not count as model-requested tools
schedule: cryptographically shuffled case-by-mode trajectories; 1-3 concurrent trajectories, sequential calls within each trajectory; synchronous shared global reservations
humanScoring: required; four metrics each 0-2; blank labels must never become quality results
blinding: random trajectory labels; identity map stored separately; generated prose may still reveal method clues
holdoutBoundary: repository-visible inputs are frozen holdout definitions, not a sealed blinded input set
